techcentral.title: Assistant messages and fixed copy

safety-stop.text: Stop the printer if it's safe to, and tell staff right now. They're at the desk, {{staff-desk.direction_from_kiosk}}.

privacy-notice.text: This screen is public. Don't type personal information. Everything is erased when you finish.

refusal-not-in-guide.text: I don't have that in TechCentral's guide, so I don't want to guess. Staff at the desk can help. They're {{staff-desk.direction_from_kiosk}}.

refusal-off-topic.text: I can only help with printing and 3D printing here. For anything else, staff can point you the right way.

answer-label.text: AI answer · from TechCentral's guide · checked {date}

techcentral.title: My print didn't come out

symptoms.choice: My job isn't at the release station
symptoms.cause: Your job may have gone to a different printer, or it waited longer than {{printing.hold_time}} and was cleared.
fixes: On the release screen, check you're looking under the right name: {{printing.release_needs}}.
On the computer, check that you chose {{printing.printer_name}} when you printed.
If it's been more than {{printing.hold_time}}, send it again.

symptoms.cause: There isn't enough on your card for this print.
fixes: Black-and-white costs less: {{printing.price_bw}} a page, compared with {{printing.price_color}} for color.
